questions.questionText: The traders reduce the risk of loss in currency fluctuations through which of the following?
questions.questionTextEn: The traders reduce the risk of loss in currency fluctuations through which of the following?
questions.explanation: Hedging is used by business to manage their currency exposure. If a business needs to buy or sell one currency for another. They are exposed to fluctuations in the foreign exchange market that could affect their costs (or revenues) and ultimately their profit. Hedging cover the risk associated with exchange rate fluctuations. By booking a hedge businesses protect an exchange rate against a specified sum for a desired times call providing businesses with certainty.

questions.questionText: The length of a business cycle is measured from:
questions.questionTextEn: The length of a business cycle is measured from:
questions.explanation: A business cycle is a cycle of fluctuations around the long-term natural growth rate in Gross Domestic Product (GDP). It explains the expansions and contractions in economic activity that an economy experiences over time. A business cycle is complete when it goes through a boom and a contraction sequentially. The time period taken to complete this sequence is called the length of the business cycle. A boom is called a period of rapid economic growth while a period of relatively stable economic growth is called a recession. These are measured in terms of real GDP growth, which is inflation-adjusted.
questions.explanationEn: A business cycle is a cycle of fluctuations around the long-term natural growth rate in Gross Domestic Product (GDP). It explains the expansions and contractions in economic activity that an economy experiences over time. A business cycle is complete when it goes through a boom and a contraction sequentially. questions.explanation: Relying on the analysis of Keynesian income determination in the kaldor model, it has been assumed that the process of change in economic activity is related to the difference in expected savings and investment of the community. Saving and investment depend on the level of production and stock of capital. Saving has a positive relationship with the accumulation of capital stock while investment has a negative relationship with capital stock in general. If there is an increase in investment (I), then there is a decrease in the stock of capital, due to which the level of income increases and savings (S) also increase. kaldor concluded that savings and investment cannot be linear, but there are some reasons why savings and investment are non-linear. Thus kaldor developed the model of endogenous and self-generating cyclical fluctuations.

questions.questionText: Accelerator theory is used to describe the trade cycle
questions.questionTextEn: Accelerator theory is used to describe the trade cycle
questions.explanation: Professor JR Hicks, in his book "A Contribution to the Theory of the Trade Cycle" (1950), based his theory of the business cycle on the basis of the law of multiplier-accelerator interaction. In which he has used some important elements – desired rate of growth, consumption function, autonomous and investment induced investment function and multiplier interrelationship (super multiplier, lever effect). Their business cycle begins with autonomous investment. Increase in the rate of autonomous investment activates the multiplier, due to which induced investment increases, as a result of which income starts increasing and due to the combined working of multiplier- accelerator, the economy moves towards growth, i.e. the economy is in growth stage. Multipliers-accelerators work together in one direction. Due to which the economy reaches the stage of full employment. But in deceleration state only multiplier works and while accelerator works almost zero or not at all.

The financial requirement for the modern firm increases so much that it is forced to raise capital from far and wide, therefore it raises capital through shares, borrowing from banks, borrowing from public etc. As a result, the shareholders play the role of its owner, due to which the role of the adventurer becomes secondary and capitalism start to be destroyed.

questions.questionText: The exponent of 'Absorption Method' was
questions.questionTextEn: The exponent of 'Absorption Method' was
questions.explanation: Sidney Alexander was the exponent of absorption method. According to Alexander, if there is a deficit in the balance of payments of a country, it means that people are absorbing more than they are producing and that they are absorbing less if there is an excess in the balance of payments. thus in this method, the difference between national income and domestic expenditure is defined on the balance of payments. TotalAbsorption balance of payment C Id X M y + − = + ↓ ↓ Where, C + Id = Total Absorption (A) X – M = Balance of payment (B) In this way, y = A + B Balance of payment (B) = y – A thus, the balance of payment is the difference between national income (y) and total absorption (A). The balance of payments can be improved by increasing domestic income or by reducing absorption.

questions.questionTextEn: There are four phases of a business cycle. the correct sequence of these stages is
questions.explanation: According to Schumpeter, there can be four stages of the business cycle– 1. Depression– Economic activities start from the state of depression or the lower surface of the business cycle. 2. Revival – The low turning point in the business cycle is where an economy moves from depression to prosperity. 3. Prosperity – The tendency of expansion in economic activities brings such a situation where the situation of full employment comes in the economy. 4. Recession – Due to investment even after attaining the position of full employment, there is no increase in real production but there is more increase in the price level in which the situation of over- employment or exploitation of resources comes.
